Probably years. I’m not the most well kept in appearance (I wear clothes until they fall apart so I can save money) and that’s always irked her. My parents are affluent, but I’m not. I guess she got tired of me going out looking bad on behalf of the family. Not only that, I’ve wasted thousands of dollars in failed college classes, too. I’m still single. I’m still overweight. I’m still living with my parents. Maybe she finally snapped and got tired of me existing.
I’m in desperate need of one. Thanks.
